description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate handheld equipment sprites for a chibi RPG character, arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each centered in its own cell with empty space around it. Top row: three variations of a child's wooden training sword (pale carved wood blade with rounded tip, short wooden crossguard, brown leather-wrapped grip), each drawn diagonally with the tip pointing to the upper right and the pommel at the lower left. Middle row: three variations of an apprentice wooden training staff (straight polished wooden shaft, small glowing light blue crystal held by a wooden claw at the top end), each drawn diagonally with the crystal end at the upper right and the butt end at the lower left. Bottom row: one small round wooden buckler shield with an iron rim and iron boss seen from the front, the same shield seen from the side as a thin vertical edge, the same shield seen from behind showing a leather hand strap. Thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm saturated palette, every sprite fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background, no text, no frame, no characters, no hands
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, palette. Do not draw this character.
